spans.s: mf(ई)n. (fr. उत्स), produced or being in a well, Pāṇ.
a descendant of Utsa g. अश्वादि, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 110.
mf(ई)n. (fr. उत्सङ्ग, g. उत्सङ्गादि, Pāṇ. iv, 4, 15) = उत्सङ्गेन हारक.
, belonging to or taught in a general rule, general, not particular or special, generally valid, Kāś.; Siddh. &c.
terminating, completing, belonging to a final ceremony by which a rite is terminated
औत्सर्गिक—त्व n. generality (of a rule &c.) Comm. on Pāṇ.
, anxiety, desire, longing for, regret, MBh.; R.; Ragh. &c.
eagerness, zeal, fervour, officiousness, Pañcat.; Kathās.
औत्सुक्य—वत् mfn. impatient, waiting impatiently for (dat.), Kathās.
